thread:
marie (Design): quick check-in on the trace UI: found a few interaction + accessibility gaps around the stackframe pane and export flow. small thread.
zara (A11y): thanks. can you list the exact issues so we can prioritize?
marie (Design): 1) inline copy icons for stack lines are only hover-accessible and have tiny targets. 2) when users copy, screen readers don't get an announcement. 3) truncated identifiers show tooltip on hover only; keyboard focus shows nothing. 4) export menu returns JSON only; customers want CSV & a minimal-column builder. 5) copying a single frame doesn't include trace_id by default which folks ask for.
sam (Eng Runtime): notes: we can make copy icons real buttons, increase target to 32px, and wire an aria-live toast. CSV needs a flatten endpoint; small backend work. Copy with trace_id could be a modifier (Shift+click) or a context menu option.
kyle (Product): which of these are high priority from customers?
anya (SRE): copy feedback is #1. folks paste stack lines into tickets with trace ids; missing trace_id is annoying. Export CSV is medium but valuable for SRE -> big query ingestion.
zara (A11y): for SR announcements: prefer aria-live="polite" and include context: "Copied to clipboard: [function] in [file:line]". Also ensure toast is focusable for keyboard users or provide role=alert.
marie (Design): proposed micro-changes: - make copy a button with aria-label="Copy stack line" and a 32px hit area - add focus-visible style and a keyboard-only tooltip for truncated names (use aria-describedby) - add Shift+Click to copy with trace id and Ctrl+Shift+C global shortcut to copy full trace - aria-live toast text as zara suggested - export menu: add CSV option + columns modal (default sanitized set) + "include PII" checkbox behind a confirmation.
sam (Eng Runtime): implementation caveats: global shortcuts must avoid browser clashes; Ctrl+Shift+C overlaps devtools on some browsers. maybe Ctrl+Alt+C? we can do Ctrl+Shift+C in desktop app only. For large traces, build CSV on server or stream in chunks to avoid blocking. Analytics: add events for copy(single), copy(with-trace), export(csv/json).
anya (SRE): security: CSV should default-strip possible secrets (headers, full messages). Show a modal listing columns that could contain sensitive content and require explicit consent to include.
marie (Design): copy microcopy question: should the toast say "Copied" or "Copied to clipboard"? and for SRs include the function name?
kyle (Product): explicit is better: "Copied to clipboard: <fn>". For large function names, truncate in the announcement but include filename + lineno.
zara (A11y): also ensure keyboard focus order in the flyout is linear: close button, export, then frame list, not jumping around. test with NVDA/VoiceOver.
sam (Eng Runtime): will scope hit area + aria-live + keyboard tooltip this sprint. CSV export and backend flatten next sprint. I'll prototype streaming copy for big traces.
marie (Design): pushed updated figma with annotations: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/trace-ui-v2 (see notes on frame actions). screenshot: https://imgur.com/traceui_annot.png
anya (SRE): small UX ask: add a tiny "copy with trace id" quick action in the frame row (three-dot menu) for mobile where modifiers are awkward.
marie (Design): good call 44d I'll add that. also adding accessibility checklist: keyboard targets >=32px, aria-live announcements, focusable tooltips, explicit CSV consent modal.
deploy-bot: scheduled perf-check: streaming-copy load test on 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z
sam (Eng Runtime): will open PR for the hit-area + aria-live. tagging @zara for a11y review in PR. thanks everyone. :slightly_smiling_face:
marie (Design): thanks team, i'll write the design notes and attach copy examples in the doc. will follow up when CSV spec is ready.
